description: This file defines the NetworkFlowMonitorClient class, a specialized client for interacting with the AWS Network Flow Monitor service. It extends the AwsClient class and includes method annotations for various synchronous and asynchronous API operations related to network flow monitoring, such as creating, deleting, retrieving, starting, stopping, and tagging monitors and scopes.

classes.name: NetworkFlowMonitorClient
classes.description: A PHP client class for interacting with AWS's Network Flow Monitor service, providing methods for managing network flow monitoring tasks and retrieving related data.

methods.description: Creates a new network flow monitor.

methods.description: Asynchronously initiates creation of a new network flow monitor.
